verbs.name: validate-local
verbs.description: Run the manifest's local validator commands in order; pass or the first failure.

repo.description: Manifest slug. Omit to resolve from the cwd's origin URL hash. Needed because the Kiro workspace is multi-root and the cwd is usually 00workdir.

verdict.description: PASS, FAIL, HUMAN or RUNNING; always the first key

results.description: validator id and PASS or FAIL

first_failure.description: output tail of the first failure

validate-local.note: Not terraform-specific: it runs whatever the manifest lists, with shell=True. Filed under terraform because every manifest that has local lines today lists terraform fmt or validate. It is the ONLY terraform verb in current use: plan and apply run in CI, and the cvg-titan-input local plan is a five-step prose recipe in the manifest, not a verb.
